purpose: Perform one bounded outcome-blind Binance USD-M perpetual 1m source/prior-use audit for the reviewed H1 benchmark prefreeze. Resolve as much as can be mechanically proven from canonical GitHub lineage and metadata-only approved local inventory; never open market rows or outcomes.

research_boundary.asset_cap_rule: Normalize eligible symbols, sort lexicographically, and if more than 12 remain take the first 12. No outcome/performance statistic may enter eligibility or ordering.
research_boundary.asset_holdout_rule: After exact eligibility freeze, lexicographic positions 5,10,... are holdout; all other eligible symbols are development assets.
research_boundary.block_rounding_rule: Whole complete UTC days from T0; any remainder is assigned to the final Chronological Confirmation block.

required_questions: What exact Binance USD-M 1m archive/source identity is mechanically supported without opening market rows?
Can at least 120 complete UTC days of common multi-symbol coverage be proven without outcomes?
What exact outcome-blind 6-12 instrument universe follows the frozen eligibility/cap rule?
What prior SC001 use applies to the exact candidate resource/window/instruments and what conservative contamination/evidence-role classification follows?
What exact DATASET_KEY and RESOURCE_ID can be frozen under the shared-data policy?
Does an already verified local raw resource or exact DERIVED_ID exist and can that identity be proven without reading market rows?
What exact Selection / Discovery / Asset Holdout / Chronological Confirmation block allocation and access boundary follows if eligibility is proven?

botmarketplace_vps_reader.list_files_allowed: ONLY if list_roots exposes an approved SC001/H1 historical-data or metadata-inventory root relevant to this exact task; never inspect unrelated roots

legacy_inventory_rule: Use the one-time legacy inventory bootstrap semantics from shared-data policy only as metadata: logical path, basename, file size, extension/type, and already-canonical hashes. Do not parse market rows. If no approved H1/SC001 data root is exposed through the allowed read-only surface, return H1_SOURCE_PRIOR_USE_AUDIT_DEFER_METADATA_ACCESS rather than opening another root or escalating tools.

untouched_requires_preopen_proof: date interval and instrument set mechanically known
no Selection/calibration inspection touched the block
task-specific evidence authorization exists before opening the block

stop_rules: If fewer than 6 eligible instruments or fewer than 120 common complete UTC days can be proven without outcomes, return H1_SOURCE_PRIOR_USE_AUDIT_DEFER_COVERAGE.

If local identity/reuse cannot be verified through the explicitly allowed metadata-only surface, return H1_SOURCE_PRIOR_USE_AUDIT_DEFER_METADATA_ACCESS; do not use Runner/Test Executor/network as a workaround.
If relevant concurrent main changes alter H1 source/evidence/governance semantics, return STALE_CONTEXT_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED.
If any step would require market-row, return, alpha, PnL, protected P1 evidence, or other outcome access, stop before access.
Do not start or propose an alternate venue/symbol/hour/horizon search.
forbidden_actions: VPS list_files on an unrelated root
claim_rule: On valid Work trigger, keep the PR title unchanged. Update only DISPATCH_STATE in the PR body from READY to IN_PROGRESS and append one CLAIM_BLOCK with a 3-hour lease. This avoids title-event recursion.
terminal_rule: Persist exact_result_path first, verify it, refresh/revalidate main, then create/update worker_result_manifest_path LAST as the final repository artifact. Add one terminal PR receipt after the manifest and stop. Never start a second task.
